basis: The domestic pig. NCBI ranks it as a subspecies of Sus scrofa (taxid 9825; synonym 'Sus scrofa domestica'); MDD does not list domestic forms separately. basis: The domestic ferret. NCBI ranks it as a subspecies of Mustela putorius (taxid 9669; synonyms Mustela furo, Putorius furo); MDD v2 lists Mustela furo as the domestic form derived from M. putorius.
